# Frame Range<AvailableFrom v="2.0.0" />

Render a subset of a video. Pass a single number to render a still, or a range (e.g. `0-9`) to render a subset of frames. Pass `100-` to render from frame 100 to the end.

## CLI flag

```text
--frames <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#framerange)
- [`renderFramesOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderframesonlambda#framerange)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#framerange)
- [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks#framerange)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#framerange)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#framerange)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#framerange)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setFrameRange(90); // To render only the 91st frame
```
